objective_summary.value: The BASS investigation aims to bridge the gap between ground-based material flammability testing and actual material flammability in microgravity using realistic fuel geometries. It also assesses the effectiveness of an inert gaseous extinguishing agent in putting out flames across various conditions.

earth_applications.value: Validated microgravity combustion models can be applied to enhance the general understanding of terrestrial combustion problems.
earth_applications.quote: These models have wide applicability to the general understanding of many terrestrial combustion problems and will guide novel spacecraft design and ensure the safety of future crewed missions.
